name: Eastman Screen Printing
old_description: Founded in 2022, Eastman Screen Printing was a dream long in the making…
about:
Eastman Screen Printing was founded in 2022 in Concord, New Hampshire, as a locally owned shop. The venture began as a long-held dream of managers Ron Dulong and Sam Mostue, who envisioned a neighborhood screen-printing service where customers could watch their promotional products being crafted by hand, much like a local candy shop.

The company provides screen printing on apparel and tote bags using plastisol, water-based, and discharge inks; embroidery with digitizing, 3D foam, and puff styles; signs, banners, and vehicle graphics printed on vinyl; and business printing including cards, brochures, flyers, and direct-mail services such as EDDM. All production is done in-house, with order volumes ranging from a single piece to over 10,000 units and rush turnaround available.

Eastman serves businesses and organizations throughout Concord and central New Hampshire. Clients include local companies such as Out on a Limb Tree Care LLC, school theatre programs, and corporate customers needing uniforms, event gear, and promotional items. The shop also handles retail-style orders for individuals and small groups.

The founders emphasize transparent, in-house production that lets clients see the work in progress, full-service support from design through delivery, and personalized service with upfront pricing. Their stated goal is to make Concord a more creative community by offering a friendly, capable local alternative for custom printing and branding.
